- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Rosalina visited the Mushroom Kingdom from her Comet Observatory and was shocked by the state of the kingdom.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Rosalina used her cosmic powers to cleanse the kingdom and restore order, healing the minds of the citizens.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some citizens were out of the kingdom during the cleansing and remained ravenous, becoming known as the "Hunters."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A small group of brave adventurers set out to confront the Hunters and restore peace to the land.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The adventurers engaged the Hunters in a fierce battle, determined to protect the innocent and end the reign of terror.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Hunters were ultimately defeated, and the adventurers were hailed as heroes for their bravery and determination.
